sentences.name: full_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel long-axis slab tapered along its depth and arrayed in section; each repeat steps back from the east road giving a graduated facade. Storey 5 fills FAR. Access east reads the tapering profile directly from the street.

sentences.name: full_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Long-axis full-parcel bar split lengthwise then re-joined with a bridging spine; the seam creates a covered interior street. East access enters the joint. North half is lower to honour the sunlight setback taper from 11.4 m up.

sentences.name: full_la_branch_pack_stack
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel long-axis base with stacked branch arms packing upward; the branching reads as a sequence of horizontal fins. East entry at ground. North branch arm held back one storey to respect the sunlight plane.

sentences.name: full_la_skew_reflect_pack
sentences.rationale: Long-axis bar skewed diagonally then reflected and packed; the paired wedge volumes create a V-plan reading along the east facade. 5 storeys at target FAR well below capacity ceiling.

sentences.name: full_la_bend_stack
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel long-axis bar bent mid-span and stacked; the upper bent slab oversails the lower producing a canopy above the east entrance. Stack keeps north shoulder lower than south.

sentences.name: full_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/1 long-axis: a secondary volume embedded inside the primary bar, with branches extruding east toward the road as covered loggias. North side of branches stays below 9 m setback threshold.

sentences.name: full_la_expand_nest
sentences.rationale: Long-axis full volume expanded outward then nested inner void; the ring section reads as a double-skin building with service zone between layers. East ring thicker for access and lobby.

sentences.name: full_sa_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel short-axis bar rotated in plan then arrayed and stacked; the rotation angle opens a diagonal courtyard slot. Access east on the rotated face. North stack kept one storey shorter.

sentences.name: full_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full slab progressively tapered from base to crown and arrayed in plan; produces a fan arrangement when read from east. 5 storeys reaches mid-FAR comfortably.

sentences.name: full_sa_inflate_pack
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel short-axis volume inflated laterally then packed in pairs; the billowing sides create soft street edges. East inflate face forms the principal entrance bay. Lower FAR justified by wider public ground-floor.

sentences.name: full_sa_expand_reflect
sentences.rationale: Short-axis bar expanded along the x-axis and reflected; the mirrored pair flanks the road with a gate-like silhouette. Both halves share an east threshold. North arm one storey shorter per setback.

sentences.name: full_sa_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/1 short-axis: compact transverse bar with embedded service core and east-facing branch loggia. The branch reads from the road as a projecting porch at each storey. North stays flush.

sentences.name: full_sa_intersect_split
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel short-axis slab intersected with an inclined solid then split; the inclined cut appears as a diagonal slash on the east elevation. North portion is the lower half of the split.

sentences.name: full_sa_bend_branch
sentences.rationale: Short-axis full bar bent transversely so the top curves south, then a branch arm reaches east; the curve keeps mass away from the north boundary. Branch defines the public entrance.

sentences.name: full_v_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel vertical tower rotated slightly about z and stacked in section; each storey packet offsets, producing a spiralling elevation. East access at base. North face offset inward on upper floors.

sentences.name: full_v_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: Vertical full-parcel volume pinched at mid-height then joined to a secondary element and arrayed; pinch creates a waist reading as a transition storey. East face unobstructed for access.

sentences.name: full_v_carve
sentences.rationale: Vertical compact volume with a large carve on the west face opening a semi-outdoor atrium. East entrance remains solid. Carve reduces massing on the north side above 11 m.

sentences.name: full_v_fracture
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel vertical bar fractured along a diagonal plane; the two halves tilt apart slightly creating an outdoor slot visible from east. North half is the shorter retained portion.

sentences.name: full_v_overlap
sentences.rationale: Two full vertical volumes overlapping at the north-east corner; the overlap zone is a shared circulation core. East access reads through the gap between the two bars.

sentences.name: full_v_carve_offset
sentences.rationale: Vertical full volume carved on the south face then offset outward; the offset mass creates a shadow band canopy. Lower FAR earned by expanded ground void for public pause.

sentences.name: full_v_lift_extrude
sentences.rationale: Full-parcel vertical bar lifted off the ground by piloti then extruded in cross-section; the raised floor plane opens a permeable ground level. East access ramp rises to lobby. North face setback above 9 m.

sentences.name: thin_la_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Very thin long-axis sliver rotated and arrayed in a stacked fan; the narrow profiles create a layered screen mass readable from east. Compact footprint leaves ground open.

sentences.name: thin_la_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: 1/16 long-axis sliver pinched at waist, joined to a transverse strip, and arrayed; the pinch-and-join repetition forms a folded lattice. East face open for access at each bay.

sentences.name: thin_la_carve
sentences.rationale: Thin long-axis bar carved on its broad face; the recess creates a semi-external corridor along the east road. Slender profile keeps the north shadow to a minimum.

sentences.name: thin_la_overlap
sentences.rationale: 1/16 slender bars overlapping in a staggered long-axis arrangement; the overlap zone is a shared stair tower. East access aligns with overlap joint.

sentences.name: thin_la_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: Thin long-axis bar with a narrower volume embedded inside and the assembly shifted to overlap a secondary strip; the layered section reads from east as a deep mullion facade.

sentences.name: thin_la_embed_taper
sentences.rationale: 1/16 long-axis: slim bar with embedded inner spine and tapering crown; the crown taper steps back from the north sky-plane at upper floors. East access at full-height slot.

sentences.name: thin_la_branch_expand
sentences.rationale: Slender long-axis bar with a branching east arm that expands into a wider head; the T-silhouette creates an overhang above the east entry. North arm kept below setback height.

sentences.name: thin_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/16 short-axis thin strip tapered and arrayed; the repeated taper gives an accordion-like east elevation. Minimal footprint maximises separation between strips.

sentences.name: thin_sa_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: Short-axis slim bar pinched at mid-height, joined longitudinally, and arrayed; the pinches occur at alternating heights creating a diagonal rhythm across the east facade.

sentences.name: thin_sa_branch_pack_stack
sentences.rationale: Thin short-axis bar with stacked branch arms packed into a narrow east tower; each branch arm acts as a projecting balcony. Compact depth suits narrow parcel dimension.

sentences.name: thin_sa_skew_reflect_pack
sentences.rationale: 1/16 short-axis sliver skewed and reflected then packed; the reflected pair form a narrow V-channel open to the north sky. East access between the two skewed faces.

sentences.name: thin_sa_fracture
sentences.rationale: Short-axis thin bar fractured along a near-vertical diagonal; the fracture gap is a covered threshold slot. East face holds the access while north fragment is shorter.

sentences.name: thin_sa_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: 1/16 short-axis sliver: embedded secondary strip overlapping the primary to build depth; the overlap doubles the effective section at the east facade.

sentences.name: thin_sa_bend_bend
sentences.rationale: Thin short-axis bar bent twice in opposite directions forming a shallow S-curve in plan; the S-plan orients the east face squarely to the road while the north end angles away from the boundary.

sentences.name: thin_v_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/16 vertical needle tapered and arrayed around the site centre; the cluster of tapering spires is read as a single sculptural mass from east. Low ground coverage freed for public realm.

sentences.name: thin_v_split_join
sentences.rationale: Slim vertical volume split along the y-axis then re-joined at base and crown; the split body frames a thin north-south slot court visible from east.

sentences.name: thin_v_compress
sentences.rationale: 1/16 vertical bar compressed laterally producing a flattened disc-like profile at mid-height; the compressed waist yields a distinctive two-zone silhouette. East access at the wider base.

sentences.name: thin_v_grade
sentences.rationale: Thin vertical volume graded so that the east face pitches outward; the inclined east face shelters the street entrance below. North face remains vertical.

sentences.name: thin_v_lodge
sentences.rationale: 1/16 vertical bar lodged against a secondary plinth volume; the lodge joint reads as a horizontal datum band at the third storey. East access through plinth.

sentences.name: thin_v_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Thin vertical volume with embedded core and east-branching arm at the top two storeys; the cantilevered branch arm creates an observation lookout over the road.

sentences.name: thin_v_expand_shift
sentences.rationale: 1/16 vertical: top half of the bar expanded in plan and shifted east; the overhanging expanded crown shelters the east entry. North side of crown stays within sunlight envelope.

sentences.name: half_la_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel long-axis bar rotated 15 degrees from the grid and stacked; the rotation aligns the major elevation to the slightly oblique road direction. East access on rotated face.

sentences.name: half_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel long-axis volume tapered in two directions and arrayed; dual taper creates a pointed plan form at the north end. East access at the wider south end.

sentences.name: half_la_compress
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel long-axis slab compressed in height to 4 storeys; the low profile activates the rooftop as a public terrace accessible from the road. Lower storey count earned by usable roof.

sentences.name: half_la_lodge
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel long-axis bar lodged against the north boundary producing a L-shaped ground plan with a south-facing court. East access through the shorter east wing.

sentences.name: half_la_expand_nest
sentences.rationale: Half long-axis volume expanded outward then nested; the ring plan reads as a doughnut section with a central open void. East face is the primary occupied ring.

sentences.name: half_la_intersect_intersect
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel long-axis bar intersected twice with inclined secondary volumes; the cross-cuts appear as diagonal reveals on both east and west elevations.

sentences.name: half_la_taper_bend
sentences.rationale: Half long-axis slab tapered along the z-axis then bent about a horizontal axis; the tapering bent profile gives a gently curved pitched silhouette. East face shows full taper height.

sentences.name: half_sa_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel short-axis volume rotated and stacked in a pinwheel arrangement; the rotation reads as a dynamic corner condition on the east facade. Access through the rotated slot.

sentences.name: half_sa_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: Half short-axis bar pinched at the second storey then joined to an east wing and arrayed; the pinch-wing creates a cruciform section at mid-height visible from road.

sentences.name: half_sa_branch_pack_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel short-axis base with branch arms stacked and packed east; the stack of branches reads as a stepped balcony system. North arm is lowest in the stack.

sentences.name: half_sa_grade
sentences.rationale: Half short-axis slab graded so that its top surface inclines from south to north; the inclined roof directs rainwater and reduces north-side bulk. East entry at the higher south end.

sentences.name: half_sa_carve_offset
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel short-axis volume carved on the east face then offset outward; the offset creates a canopy cantilevered over the east entry path. North carve edge respects the sunlight plane.

sentences.name: half_sa_split_split
sentences.rationale: Half short-axis bar split twice producing three parallel slabs; the triple-slab section frames two covered outdoor passages. East access enters the central passage.

sentences.name: half_sa_shift_notch
sentences.rationale: Half short-axis slab shifted laterally then notched at the corners; the shift creates an offset plan while notches soften street corners at the east entry.

sentences.name: half_v_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel vertical tower rotated and stacked in section; each section packet twists slightly producing a spiralling tower. East access constant throughout. North face offset on upper storeys.

sentences.name: half_v_embed
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel vertical volume with a service core embedded inside producing a hollow-core section; the core aligns north-south and its shadow relief is visible on east facade.

sentences.name: half_v_inflate
sentences.rationale: Half vertical bar inflated along the y-axis to create a lens-shaped section; the east face remains flat for access while the west bulge pushes toward the interior.

sentences.name: half_v_puncture
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel vertical volume punctured through its depth creating a horizontal tunnel at mid-height; the tunnel opens north-south providing a shaded view corridor from east street.

sentences.name: half_v_carve_offset
sentences.rationale: Half vertical volume carved on the south face and the carved piece offset to the east; the offset element forms an entrance canopy. North face kept flush with setback line.

sentences.name: half_v_split_split
sentences.rationale: Half vertical tower split twice along vertical planes producing a three-finger plan; each finger has its own east-facing facade bay. North finger is set back from the boundary.

sentences.name: half_v_taper_bend
sentences.rationale: Half-parcel vertical: taper narrows the top then a bend leans the crown east; the lean brings the upper floors closer to the east road while maintaining north setback.

sentences.name: qtr_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Quarter-parcel long-axis bar tapered in plan and arrayed as a stepped cascade along the east road; each array element steps back creating a terraced east elevation.

sentences.name: qtr_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Quarter long-axis bar split and rejoined with a narrow bridge element; the bridge is glass, allowing the east entry light to penetrate to the north court behind.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed
sentences.rationale: 1/4 long-axis: a thin secondary bar embedded in the primary creating a double-layer east facade; the outer layer is open access, the inner layer is occupied offices.

sentences.name: qtr_la_inflate
sentences.rationale: Quarter long-axis bar inflated vertically; the inflated midsection gives a barrel-vaulted cross-section visible from east. Access enters at the wider mid-height base.

sentences.name: qtr_la_overlap_expand
sentences.rationale: Quarter long-axis volume overlapping with an expanded secondary element; overlap junction is the circulation core, and the expanded outer forms east-facing offices.

sentences.name: qtr_la_split_split
sentences.rationale: Quarter-parcel long-axis bar split twice in cross-section; three nested slabs create a deep-ribbed east facade. Each rib gap is an open-air planting corridor.

sentences.name: qtr_la_shift_notch
sentences.rationale: Quarter long-axis slab shifted north then notched at its east corners; the shift reduces the ground floor shadow on the south neighbour. Notches form the east entry bay.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Quarter-parcel short-axis strip tapered in plan and arrayed along x; the array forms a comb of fins pointing east. Each fin tip is a double-height lobby.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_expand
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis volume expanded east to fill the legal ground plan envelope then held at 5 storeys; the expansion gives maximum ground activation. East face is a flush wall with recessed entry.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_inscribe
sentences.rationale: Quarter short-axis bar inscribed within a cylindrical envelope producing a curved east facade; the curved surface reflects the road curve and opens a crescent-shaped entry plaza.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_rotate
sentences.rationale: Quarter-parcel short-axis bar rotated 30 degrees to face the road obliquely; the angled facade creates a funnel toward the east access and a shaded north recess.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/4 short-axis: embedded secondary core with east-facing branch arms at each storey; the branches read as a projecting bay window system from the road.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_bend_branch
sentences.rationale: Quarter short-axis bar bent toward north then a branch arm reaches east; the bend shifts mass away from the north boundary while the branch presents the east facade to the road.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_notch_twist
sentences.rationale: Quarter short-axis bar notched at the north-east corner then twisted slightly in section; the notch carves an entry recess and the twist angles the upper floors away from the neighbour.

sentences.name: qtr_v_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: Quarter-parcel vertical tower rotated 45 degrees and stacked in groups; the diamond plan at each level produces corner conditions equally open to east and south.

sentences.name: qtr_v_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical bar pinched at two storey heights, joined into a second element and arrayed; the double pinch creates three distinct tower zones. East face is main access zone.

sentences.name: qtr_v_split_join
sentences.rationale: Quarter vertical volume split then rejoined by a thin bridge at the fourth storey; the split creates a north–south gap that opens views through from east to west.

sentences.name: qtr_v_expand
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical bar expanded outward at upper floors to reach the legal plan limit; the expanding crown maximises upper-floor area without exceeding ground coverage. East face remains straight.

sentences.name: qtr_v_inscribe
sentences.rationale: Quarter vertical bar inscribed in an ellipse producing a curved tower shaft; the ellipse plan aligns with the east access axis. North arc kept within setback.

sentences.name: qtr_v_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: 1/4 vertical: compact tower with embedded service core and two east-facing branch meeting pods at levels 3 and 5. The cantilevered pods create a distinctive stepped east elevation.

sentences.name: qtr_v_intersect_split
sentences.rationale: Quarter vertical tower intersected with an inclined plane then split; the intersected portion becomes a skew-cut top on the north face that respects the sunlight envelope.

sentences.name: eighth_la_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis blade rotated and stacked in a vertical array; the stacked blades form a layered screen tower read as a single mass from east. Thin plan maximises north-south air flow.

sentences.name: eighth_la_pack_inflate
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis bar with inflated pairs packed side-by-side; the inflation creates a convex profile on east and west. East inflated face is the access elevation.

sentences.name: eighth_la_expand
sentences.rationale: Eighth long-axis blade expanded at upper floors to widen the plan; the expanded top is the primary occupied floor while the slender base is open colonnade. East colonnade is the entrance.

sentences.name: eighth_la_twist
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis bar twisted along its vertical axis; the twist rotates the top 45 degrees from the base giving a dynamic silhouette. East face at base aligns to road.

sentences.name: eighth_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Eighth long-axis bar with embedded spine and east-branching wing at upper floors; the branch reads as a projecting canopy over the east entry. North side stays within the upper setback.

sentences.name: eighth_la_intersect_split
sentences.rationale: 1/8 long-axis: inclined intersecting volume cuts through the bar then splits; the cut appears as a diagonal slash on the east and west faces simultaneously.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis thin strip tapered progressively and arrayed forming a wedge cascade. The cascade reads from east as an inclined staircase of rooflines.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_bend
sentences.rationale: Eighth short-axis bar bent about its long axis; the bent cross-section creates a curved lateral profile. East face of the bent bar becomes the convex entry facade.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_interlock
sentences.rationale: Two 1/8 short-axis bars interlocked at right angles; the interlocking creates a cruciform plan read from east as a plus-sign silhouette. East arm is the access branch.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_shear
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis bar sheared so that upper floors slide east; the shear produces a parallelogram section and the east face overhangs the entry level creating a canopy.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: Eighth short-axis bar with embedded inner strip and overlapping east volume; the overlap zone doubles as a circulation bridge between the two elements.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_shift_embed
sentences.rationale: 1/8 short-axis bar with split halves embedded in one another; the result is a compact T-section that reads as a deep column from east.

sentences.name: eighth_v_taper_array
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical needle tapered and arrayed around the parcel perimeter; the clustered needles read as a thicket of slender towers from east. Ground level remains open between bases.

sentences.name: eighth_v_bend
sentences.rationale: Eighth vertical needle bent mid-height so the top half leans east over the road; the lean reads as a dramatic overhang from the street. North face of the bend is the tightest face.

sentences.name: eighth_v_notch
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical bar notched at the north-east corner creating a chamfered entry recess; the notch frames the east access and reduces the abrupt corner to the north side.

sentences.name: eighth_v_shear
sentences.rationale: Eighth vertical needle sheared so upper floors slide east; the parallelogram section overhangs the entry and gives a distinctive inclined east face.

sentences.name: eighth_v_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: 1/8 vertical slender volume with embedded core overlapping a secondary plinth element; the plinth grounds the needle and provides the east access.

sentences.name: eighth_v_branch_expand
sentences.rationale: Eighth vertical tower with a branching east arm that expands into a wider head; the branch-head overhangs the road as an observation deck above the east entry.

sentences.name: lshape_la_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: L-shaped three-octant long-axis mass rotated and stacked; the L-rotation places the short wing at north and the long wing faces east. Access through east long wing.

sentences.name: lshape_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: L-plan 3/8 long-axis volume tapered in section and arrayed horizontally; each array element is one storey shorter on the north arm.

sentences.name: lshape_la_bend
sentences.rationale: 3/8 long-axis L-volume bent at the junction of its two arms; the bend opens the internal angle producing a concave east courtyard. North arm shorter per sunlight setback.

sentences.name: lshape_la_notch
sentences.rationale: L-plan long-axis 3/8 volume with notches at each internal and external corner; notches create sheltered entry recesses at the east arm tip and the internal angle.

sentences.name: lshape_la_overlap_expand
sentences.rationale: 3/8 long-axis: two arms of the L overlap at the corner and the overlapping section expands to span the gap; the expanded corner is a communal space visible from east.

sentences.name: lshape_la_bend_bend
sentences.rationale: 3/8 long-axis L bent twice: first at mid-arm, then at the elbow; the double bend creates a gently curved L-plan that follows the parcel's oblique east boundary.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: L-shaped 3/8 short-axis volume rotated so the short arm faces the road and stacked; the east short arm frames an entry porch at each storey.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: 3/8 short-axis L pinched at the elbow, joined to a spine strip and arrayed; the pinch-and-join creates a double-L plan that opens a slot court between repetitions.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_extrude
sentences.rationale: 3/8 short-axis L extruded vertically with varying floor heights; the taller short arm reads as a tower on the east side while the long arm is a lower podium.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_shift
sentences.rationale: 3/8 short-axis L-volume shifted east so the elbow aligns with the road setback; the shift exposes the internal angle as a semi-public recess visible from the east access.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_lift_carve
sentences.rationale: 3/8 short-axis L lifted off the ground on piloti and carved on its inner face; the lift opens the ground and the carve reveals a covered internal passage from east.

sentences.name: lshape_sa_embed_taper
sentences.rationale: 3/8 short-axis L-volume with embedded service core in the long arm and tapering crown on the short arm; east entry at the short arm below the taper.

sentences.name: lshape_v_rotate_array_stack
sentences.rationale: L-shaped 3/8 vertical volume rotated so both arms rise equally and stacked as section cuts; the stacked L reads as a layered pinwheel from east.

sentences.name: lshape_v_pinch_join_array
sentences.rationale: 3/8 vertical L pinched at the elbow, joined with a transverse bridge, and arrayed vertically; the bridge at the elbow creates a covered horizontal connection visible from east.

sentences.name: lshape_v_branch
sentences.rationale: 3/8 vertical L with east-facing branch arm at the top of the short arm; the branch creates a T at the crown that reads as a wide roof from the road.

sentences.name: lshape_v_intersect
sentences.rationale: 3/8 vertical L intersected at its elbow with an inclined solid; the intersection cuts a diagonal chunk from the elbow creating a triangular recess at the east face.

sentences.name: lshape_v_bend_shift
sentences.rationale: 3/8 vertical L bent at the elbow then one arm shifted east; the bend and shift open the internal angle to north light while the east arm presents a straight access face.

sentences.name: lshape_v_intersect_intersect
sentences.rationale: 3/8 vertical L intersected twice with perpendicular inclined volumes; the double cut creates a bevelled L silhouette. Each cut face is an inclined glazed surface on the east and north arms.
